title: Mediterranean Steak Skewers
description: Grilled steak skewers with a Mediterranean twist, featuring feta cheese, olives, and sun-dried tomatoes.

ingredients.name: Steak
ingredients.notes: 1.5-2 pounds steak, preferably ribeye or sirloin

instructions: Thread steak, bell peppers, onions, zucchini, and mushrooms onto skewers.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until steak reaches 135°F for medium-rare.
Meanwhile, toast pita bread on the grill or in a toaster.
Top toasted pita bread with crumbled feta cheese, chopped olives, and sun-dried tomatoes.
Serve skewers with feta-topped pita bread on the side.
Let steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
